sources.claim: Uptycs reports that several recent Gafgyt variants reused modules and implementations from Mirai source code.
Trend Micro reports that a GAFGYT variant added modules derived from Mirai malware, including DDoS and Telnet brute-force modules.
The Bashlite/Mirai evolution paper says Mirai source code is based on Bashlite's and that the botnets share many similarities.

curator_note: Modeled as shares_code_with rather than derived_from because the public evidence is bidirectional over time: Mirai builds on Bashlite/Gafgyt lineage, while later Gafgyt variants reuse Mirai modules. This edge does not imply a single clean ancestry direction.
confidence_reason: Two vendor sources identify Gafgyt variants reusing Mirai code, and an academic measurement paper describes Mirai as Bashlite's successor with source-code basis.
